notes: Mass make-shiny: open a Gen 3 game's Edit save → PC Boxes and tap the sparkle to make every boxed Pokémon legally shiny at once (nature, gender, ability and IVs are all preserved). Event Pokémon (Mew, Deoxys, Jirachi, Celebi) are skipped, since a shiny event Pokémon would be illegal. Backs up your save first.
